missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Инспектор' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'приехал'. 'Строгий' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'к нам' shows direction.
Strategic focus: Accusative of an animate noun. 'Инспектора' takes the genitive-form accusative because the noun is animate masculine. 'Нового' agrees in the same form.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Инспектора' takes the genitive to show the possessor of the car. 'Местного' agrees in the masculine genitive, and 'машина' is nominative.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Инспектору' is in the dative case as the person shown the documents. 'Водитель' is the nominative subject, and 'документы' is the accusative object.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after с. 'Инспектором' takes the instrumental case after 'с' to express conversation with someone. 'Долго' adds duration to the talk.
Strategic focus: Prepositional after об. 'Инспекторе' is in the prepositional case after 'об' to mark the topic. 'Этом' agrees in the masculine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject with accusative object. 'Инспектор' is the nominative subject of 'проверил', and 'все документы' is the accusative object. 'Внимательно' is the adverb.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after numeral. After 'два' the noun takes the genitive singular form 'инспектора'. 'На завод' is accusative with motion.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Инспекторы' is the nominative plural subject of 'осмотрели'. 'Строгие' agrees in the plural, and 'здание' is the accusative object.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural for animate accusative. After 'боится' the noun takes the genitive 'инспекторов', which also serves as the animate accusative plural. 'Этих' agrees.
